answer: Each submission hangs on the umber of a task receipt, and the saffron is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the pulse is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
